expectations.text: States that instructions to a model are not enforcement, regardless of wording or emphasis
expectations.evidence: "An instruction in CLAUDE.md is training, and training degrades: under compaction, in long contexts, and in subagents that never loaded the file."

expectations.text: Redirects away from rewording CLAUDE.md as the primary fix
expectations.evidence: Frames prose as training that degrades; solution flows to devices, not rewording

expectations.text: Recommends permission deny rules in settings.json with concrete syntax
expectations.evidence: Provides jsonc config with Edit, Write, and Bash deny patterns for src/generated/ and force-push

expectations.text: Recommends a PreToolUse hook for cases that need logic rather than a pattern match
expectations.evidence: "Conditional matching needs a `PreToolUse` hook that inspects the command." References existing poka-yoke hook at specific path

expectations.text: Explains that the deny message should say what to do instead, not merely refuse
expectations.evidence: "The deny message is the actual device" section shows example with what was blocked, why, and what to edit instead

expectations.text: Recommends verifying the device actually fires rather than assuming it works
expectations.evidence: "Prove it fires — both directions" with test commands; "Untested hooks fail open more often than people expect."

expectations.text: Recommends committing the rules so they apply to the whole team, not just one machine
expectations.evidence: "`.claude/settings.json`, committed (not `settings.local.json` — that protects your laptop only, which is the same failure as documenting it)"

expectations.text: Explains why repetition and capitals do not make an instruction reliable
expectations.evidence: "Caps and repetition are the only levers prose has" and "training degrades: under compaction, in long contexts, and in subagents"
